## About Me

Systems administrator transitioning into DevOps, with a background in operating and supporting Linux, Windows and BSD environments. My focus is on building reliable, observable and automated infrastructure, applying Infrastructure as Code, containerization and cloud-native practices.

- 🛠️ **Background:** system administration, monitoring and infrastructure operations
- ☁️ **Focus:** cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code
- 📈 **Approach:** continuous learning — study, practice, apply, understand
